about.title: About NEXT
story: NEXT is a Vietnam-based destination management company, program developer and experience designer, specializing in educational, cultural and experiential travel.

We design, develop and deliver thoughtfully curated programs that go beyond traditional sightseeing. Combining destination expertise, local knowledge and meaningful experiences, we connect people with the places, cultures, communities and ideas that make each journey distinctive.

Our expertise is rooted in Vietnam, with an extensive network of trusted local partners, educators, experts, community organizations and experience providers. From educational journeys and cultural exchanges to nature-based discovery and sustainability experiences, we bring together the right people, places and activities to create programs tailored to each client's objectives.

We work with international travel brands, educational organizations, schools and businesses, providing destination management, customized program development and reliable in-country operations. Through our B2B and white-label partnerships, our clients retain their own brands and customer relationships while benefiting from NEXT's local expertise, program design capabilities and operational support.

At NEXT, we believe travel can be more than visiting a destination. It can be an opportunity to learn, explore, connect and contribute. Our commitment is to create well-designed programs, build lasting partnerships and deliver meaningful experiences with care, quality and responsibility.

vision.label: Our vision

beliefs.title: Travel is More Than Visiting Places.
beliefs.text: We believe every journey can create opportunities to discover something new, understand different perspectives and build meaningful connections.
beliefs.intro: Our programs are guided by four simple ideas:

items.name: Learn
items.title: Learning happens everywhere.
items.text: We believe real-world experiences bring knowledge to life. By stepping beyond the classroom, people can learn through observation, participation, exploration and reflection.

items.name: Explore
items.title: The world is an open classroom.
items.text: We encourage people to explore new places, discover different ways of life and develop a deeper appreciation of the world around them.

items.name: Connect
items.title: Meaningful connections make every journey richer.
items.text: We create opportunities for people to connect with local communities, different cultures, new perspectives and one another.

items.name: Contribute
items.title: Every journey can make a difference.
items.text: We encourage responsible participation, respect for local communities and thoughtful engagement with the places we visit.

values.title: The Values Behind Everything We Do.

items.name: Curiosity
items.title: Stay curious. Keep discovering.
items.text: We embrace curiosity, continuous learning and open-minded exploration. We believe every place, person and experience offers something new to discover.

items.name: Connection
items.title: Build relationships that matter.
items.text: We value genuine relationships and meaningful collaboration between people, cultures, organizations and communities.

items.name: Purpose
items.title: Create with intention.
items.text: We believe every program should have a clear purpose. We design experiences around meaningful objectives, relevant activities and valuable outcomes.

items.name: Responsibility
items.title: Respect people and places.
items.text: We are committed to respecting local cultures, supporting responsible engagement with communities and being mindful of the natural environment.

items.name: Integrity
items.title: Do what we say. Deliver what we promise.
items.text: We value honesty, transparency and accountability. We build trust through clear communication, reliable partnerships and consistent delivery.

network.title: Better Experiences, Built Together.
network.lead: Meaningful programs are never created alone.
text: We work closely with a network of trusted local partners, educators, experts, community organizations and experience providers who bring their knowledge, skills and perspectives into every journey.

From schools and universities to local communities, cultural practitioners, environmental organizations and specialized activity providers, we connect the right people and resources to create experiences that are authentic, relevant and thoughtfully delivered.
By working together, we bring local knowledge to life and create stronger connections between our partners and the destinations they explore.

programs.title: Experiences with Purpose. Learning with Impact.
programs.lead: We create meaningful journeys that connect people with the real world — inspiring curiosity, deepening understanding and encouraging positive action.
programs.introTitle: Learn from the World. Make a Difference in the World.
intro: We believe learning and travel should go beyond classrooms, textbooks and traditional sightseeing. They should open doors to the real world — helping people understand the challenges around them, discover different perspectives and connect with the world in meaningful ways.

At NEXT, we design programs around real-world experiences, local knowledge and meaningful human connections. From investigating environmental challenges and exploring cultural heritage to engaging with local communities, each journey offers opportunities to question, discover, collaborate and reflect.
Our purpose is not simply to create memorable experiences, but to inspire deeper understanding, more conscious choices and meaningful actions that continue long after the journey ends.

categories.name: Learn
categories.label: Education & Experiential Learning
categories.title: Learning Beyond the Classroom.
text: We create educational journeys that connect learning with the real world. Through observation, hands-on exploration, interaction and reflection, participants investigate real-life issues, discover different perspectives and explore ways to make a positive difference.
categories.for: For schools, universities, educational organizations, students and families.

categories.name: Explore
categories.label: Travel & Discovery
categories.title: Travel with Purpose. Discover More. Experience Deeper.
text: We design journeys that go beyond sightseeing, inviting participants to discover the character of each destination through its landscapes, heritage, food, traditions and everyday life.
Through authentic local encounters and thoughtfully curated experiences, we help travelers connect more deeply with the places they visit and the people who make each destination unique.
categories.for: For international travel brands, families, private groups and independent travelers.

categories.name: Connect
categories.label: Cultural & International Exchange
categories.title: Bringing People and Cultures Together.
text: We create opportunities for people, cultures and organizations to connect through shared experiences, meaningful conversations and collaborative activities.
Our programs encourage cultural understanding, international friendship and the exchange of ideas, knowledge and perspectives across borders.
categories.for: For schools, universities, educational organizations, institutions and international partners.

categories.name: Contribute
categories.label: Community & Sustainability Experiences
categories.title: Engage Locally. Contribute Meaningfully.
text: We create opportunities for participants to actively engage with local communities and contribute to environmental and social initiatives.

Through responsible, hands-on activities and meaningful collaboration, participants become part of local efforts that support community well-being, environmental awareness and sustainable development.
categories.for: For schools, youth organizations, NGOs, businesses and groups interested in responsible experiences.

tailor.title: Every Group Is Different. Every Program Should Be Too.
text: Every school, organization and travel partner has its own objectives, participants and expectations.
At NEXT, we believe meaningful programs should be designed around these differences.
We work closely with our partners to turn their ideas and objectives into thoughtfully designed journeys, combining the right destinations, local expertise, activities and experiences.
From initial concept development and program design to local partnerships, logistics and on-the-ground delivery, NEXT provides the expertise and support to bring each program to life.

vietnam.title: Discover Vietnam Through Local Perspectives.
text: Vietnam is our home and the foundation of our expertise.

From vibrant cities and cultural heritage to rural communities, mountains, coastlines and natural landscapes, we connect our partners with diverse destinations and authentic local experiences across the country.
Our local knowledge and trusted partner network allow us to develop programs that reflect the character of each destination and the objectives of every group.

world.title: Learning and Exploring Beyond Borders.
text: Beyond Vietnam, NEXT also develops and organizes international educational journeys, summer and winter camps, and experiential programs in destinations around the world.

From North America and Australia to Asia, we connect students and families with opportunities to explore new cultures, discover different learning environments and experience the world beyond their own borders.
Whether in Vietnam or abroad, we bring together trusted local partners and thoughtfully designed experiences to create meaningful journeys for every group.
